metadata.name: MiniMax-VL-01
metadata.params_total: 456B language backbone + 303M vision encoder + projector (aggregate not stated)
metadata.variant_policy: Separate Text-01 and VL-01 checkpoints; VL-01 adds a vision encoder and projector to Text-01.

backbone.context_window_notes: Released VL config text_config.max_position_embeddings=8192, whereas inherited Text-01 long-context statements do not establish the supported VL product limit. No silent inheritance of 4M.

variants.name: lightning_attention
variants.rope: RoPE is documented for the softmax branch; no rotary operation assumed for linear attention.
variants.notes: Lightning Attention: I/O-aware linear attention with recurrent state and blockwise execution (MiniMax-01 report §§2.1–2.2).

variants.name: gqa
variants.rope: Partial RoPE, rotary_dim=64; final checkpoint base 10000000.

attention.layer_pattern: (7 Lightning Attention layers, 1 GQA softmax layer) × 10, 80 total; config.attn_type_list has GQA at zero-based indices 7,15,...,79.
attention.notes: Pinned config: rotary_dim=64 of head_dim=128; RoPE applies to half of each attention head.

moe.routing: Top-2 routing; MoE auxiliary loss coefficient 0.01 in original Text-01 pre-training (paper §4.2).

components.normalization: RMSNorm, epsilon=1e-05; postnorm=true; DeepNorm scaling in the original Text-01 report.

architecture.parallelism_notes: Original MiniMax-01 report §3: expert/tensor/data parallelism, Expert Tensor Parallel (ETP), varlen ring attention for softmax, LASP+ for linear-attention sequence parallelism. Exact M1 deployment degrees not assumed.

training.optimizer: Text-01 backbone pre-training: AdamW, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, weight_decay=0.1 (MiniMax-01 report §4.2). Multimodal-stage optimizer not stated.
training.lr_schedule: Text-01 backbone: 500-step warmup to 2e-4; constant for 7.2T tokens; 1.3e-4 for next 3.2T; exponential decay over 1T to 3e-5; context extension adds 300B+32B+26B tokens (report §4.2).
training.data_total_tokens: Model card says 512B multimodal tokens; paper §6.3 states 80B+420B+44.8B across stages I–III (544.8B). Discrepancy unresolved; inherited Text-01 training is additional.
training.data_mix_notes: Text-01: academic literature, books, web content and code; byte-level BPE, multilingual upsampling and model-scored quality filtering. Exact domain percentages undisclosed (report §4.1).

other: Vision encoder trained with CoCa-style contrastive image-text loss plus decoder cross-entropy (report §6.2.2).

alignment.rl_method: DPO on model-scored multimodal preference pairs (report §6.3).

stages.name: Modality alignment
stages.description: Update vision encoder and adapter using 80B caption tokens at 336×336.

stages.name: Vision instruction tuning
stages.description: Unfreeze all parameters; 420B multimodal tokens mixed 20:1 with Text-01 post-training data.

stages.name: Preference tuning
stages.description: 40K image-text preference pairs scored by LLMs, including Text-01; mix pure-text pairs, early stopping before one epoch.

multimodal.fusion_notes: 303M from-scratch ViT-L/14 → randomly initialized two-layer MLP → Text-01. Dynamic image grids 336×336 to 2016×2016 plus 336×336 thumbnail; patches encoded separately and concatenated, with no pooling compression (report §6.2).

vision_encoder.notes: CLIPVisionModel config architecture; CoCa-style training, not imported CLIP pretrained weights.

open_questions: VL-01 supported user-facing context remains unresolved: checkpoint text_config says 8192, the shared report describes Text-01 trained 1M/extrapolated 4M; vendor does not reconcile the VL-specific limit.
VL-01 model card says 512B multimodal tokens; paper stage budgets 80B+420B+44.8B sum to 544.8B. Neither figure is silently chosen as an exact whole-model total.

Vision training count differs by unit/scope: card says 694M image-caption pairs; paper §6.2.2 says 37B low-resolution training pairs followed by 1.2B high-resolution pairs. Likely repeated exposures versus unique pairs, but not equated without an explicit statement.
Unknown fields are deliberate; no optimizer, token mixture, full training precision or version deltas are inherited from neighboring checkpoints without source attribution.
